text:
sam: quick idea: instead of always packing by namespace we could unbundle sparse hot prefixes out of a packed bucket on the fly. goal: reduce churn while keeping packing benefits for the true cold mass.
jin: clarify: packing still happens, but we maintain a lightweight hot-exit index so a flaring prefix gets immediate dedicated residency?
sam: yes. pack cold prefixes into buckets; have an unbundle table mapping prefix -> hot-state. reads/writes check unbundle first then bucket.
petra: main tradeoffs: extra metadata and coordination vs lower revive ratios. also need to consider lease semantics during unbundle.
omar: how do you handle races where demote starts and an unbundle comes in? need idempotent demote and a way to retract packed membership.
sam: plan: demote is epoched. unbundle writes include desired-epoch <= current-epoch check; if demote in flight we bump epoch and cancel demote for affected bucket. simple CAS on manifest.
jin: that requires strong manifest CAS which we already have for rolling-prefetch flags. cost is one extra write on contention. acceptable?
petra: tests: simulate hot-surge after demote, measure promote latency; measure how many prefixes are unbundled per hour; track bucket_revive_ratio.
omar: metrics to add: unbundle_hits, unbundle_promote_latency, demote_cancellations. also auto-disable packing for tenant if unbundle density > X.
ci-bot: smoke-canary: created job pack_unbundle_smoke. runs simulation harness with 10k micro-prefixes and random flares.
sam: rollout: staging 0.5% tenants, pack N=64 buckets, bloom FP=0.01, unbundle table in-memory + persisted manifest CAS. run 48h.
jin: one more: ensure unbundle entries expire after inactivity to avoid metadata growth. TTL plus access-based refresh.
petra: good. action items: sam prototype unbundle table + CAS on manifest; jin add manifest CAS API docs; omar wire telemetry and canary. follow-up next Tue. :thumbsup:
